chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Mudarib said:
I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him) about the eunuch, does he perform the ritual release (of the firstborn)? He said, 'He does not perform it.'

key_terms.الرِّضَا: Al-Rida (Imam Ali al-Rida, peace be upon him)
key_terms.يُحَلِّلُ: He performs the ritual release (referring to Aqiqah)

ai.seo_question: Does a eunuch have to perform the Aqiqah ritual for a newborn?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (AS) clarifies that a eunuch (*al-khasi*) is not obligated to perform the *'aqiqah* slaughter, distinguishing his status from that of a fully capable father or guardian. This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential view that the primary duty of *'aqiqah* rests on the male guardian who possesses full physical and legal capacity, thereby excluding those with specific physical impairments from this specific act of worship.
